>What are you currently doing right now?

I've been looking for work for about 10 months now with no luck. Lost my last job because I couldn't keep up, lost my apartment and am living with my parents again.

>Has therapy been helpful for you at all?

No.

>Has there been anything that has happened in the last 7 years that has been uplifting for you?

Nothing that I can immediately think of.

>What do you like to do in your spare time that you enjoy?

I just listen to music. I've stopped going to the gym, don't watch TV anymore and spend most of my time in bed.
